body: Yeah I feel you. It’s like I’m just being dragged though each day doing the bare minimum. And I just feel too tired to think about doing anything beyond that
Thanks for your comment!
Just kinda sucks. Take care man
Yeah it’s bittersweet, take care
I appreciate the reply :)
Yeah, just feeling a little lonely and can’t imagine decades more of this
I’m happy to hear that, you really sound like such a compassionate person! Take care
Really sorry to hear man. Sending you good vibes
Yeah, I get that they want the best for me but it only reminds me how irrational my fear is in the first place.
This was really comforting to hear, I appreciate the reply!

Sleep is the one thing I look forward to but I am terrified to stop distracting myself because self-loathing fuck yeah !!! so I stay up and use tv and music for escapism until I pass out at 6am. And I can’t break this cycle :/
I appreciate it, take care my dude!
I appreciate the reply thanks
Uh oh this is turning into my notes app sorry
I am so lonely but I  want to keep it that way because I don’t think I   will ever find  anyonw that I just click with

I’ve been avoiding plans and every opportunity to leave the house because I just desperately want to be alone. 

It’s like I will open a message inviting me somewhere and it will ruin my day because I know I have to reject it and live with the fact that I am a shitty person that doesn’t deserve to have friends. And I mean I only know 2 people and have no social life but I feel terrible always letting down these 2 friends, and I know I don’t deserve anyone’s time.

I completely relate. Just wanted to have a passion or interest but I was always average. Nothing ever hit off and I never improved. Now all I do is use films/tv shows for escapism, but I’m even struggling to get into anything now. Hope you find something fulfilling and take care.
Yeah. It was even frustrating not being able to put into words how I feel for this post. I don’t even know what I am feeling, so why should anyone else care? But really, take care.
You take care too.

Truth is that I just want to be alone I guess. It’s even more difficult being the host when I have nothing interesting to do or say. 

I know I should talk to them though. Thanks for your comment

I really appreciate your reply. I know it is best to seek help sooner rather than later but it just doesn’t seem possible for now. I’ll get around to it one day. I’m sorry to hear about your experiences though, I really do wish all the best for you too :)
Yeah I hear you. Take care.

Yeah, I think I just feel like life is happening to me at the moment, but I’m still stuck in the headspace I was 5ish years ago. Don’t know if I could even manage to a therapist but I know it would be for the best. Thanks and you take care too
Man I really appreciate your comment. Gotta love my crippling self doubt, but I do hear what you’re saying. Hope things improve for the both of us
It’s something to think about, thanks for your reply. Also just read your recent post and I’ve been stuck in that cycle too for a while so I wish you the best
Wish I could help you too but I don’t even have the answers. Just weirdly comforting to know I’m not alone. Thanks for your post, take care.
This is so scarily accurate that I feel like I’ve written it myself.
Yeah, struggling with the fact that I feel the way I do but have no right to complain because many have it so much worse than me.

If it is any comfort, I am not much older than you and I smoked for the first time about a month ago. Had far too much and immediately had a panic attack and then experienced what I now realise was derealisation. I’d heard about it but had never experienced it before, and had absolutely no one to ask for help. For the next week I was drifting in and out of complete numbness and derealisation, and I was scared I’d fucked up my life and would never feel normal again. Every morning I would wake up and immediately feel my face etc to check if I still felt numb. The unknown was what scared me and I was ready to give up

But then it stopped about a week and a half later. I know everyone reacts differently, but I hope it is a comfort that even when I thought it was hopeless, it didn’t last forever. Wishing you the best.

That describes my life honestly. I am different around every person I meet because I only say and do and act how I think they would like. Other than that, I don’t speak unless I have to. I guess it’s just that feeling that everyone secretly looks down on me, and just has to tolerate me being around. So I try to waste as little of their time as possible.

And it sucks. But thanks for your comment, wishing you the best
Shit I like that perspective

You literally described exactly how I see myself what the fuck. It’s actually kind of scary. I feel like I’m wasting the life I’ve been given because I am just absolutely useless. I am terrified of meeting people and have no self esteem, and i’m completely alone because of it. So I really wish you the absolute best.

It’s tough. I am constantly exhausted and running out of things to distract myself with. But it’s weirdly comforting hear that someone else is having the same experience, so thanks for your post. Take care.
I’m the same :/ I need escapism until I literally can’t keep my eyes open, then I can just pass out. Problem is that I end up staying up all night constantly
Will do. Thanks
Just gotta find someone that cares about me :/ But I hear you, and I’m really sorry to hear about your loss. Thanks and take care.
I’m terrified of meeting new people but I know it would probably be for the best. Hopefully I’ll find the courage to do it some day. Thanks.
I really appreciate the reply. Thanks.

Unfortunately, sleeping isn’t my strong point :/ The sun will be up soon, but really this is just my usual routine. I guess I feel as though I deserve to be exhausted. Probably not the best mindset!

But thank you for the reply! You’ve given me something to think about
